EC1: 1. Active thromboembolic disease [OR], history of thromboembolic disease [OR] (including retinal vein [OR] or artery occlusion), known inherited thrombophilia [OR], or family history of thrombosis in a first degree relative
EC2: 2. Subject has a severe medical or psychiatric illness that, in the opinion of the Investigator, would affect subject safety or compliance
EC3: 3. Clinical evidence of severe bleeding disorder [OR]. Patients with mild bleeding disorders such as type 1 von Willebrand disease [OR], mild platelet function defects such as platelet storage pool [OR] or release defects, and patients with bleeding [AND] due to Ehlers Danlos syndrome WILL be eligible to participate in the study.
EC4: 4. Pregnancy [OR] within the past 6 months and/or breast-feeding
EC5: 5. Use of hormonal contraception (estrogen and progestin) within 3 months of study entry, or anticipated need to initiate estrogen [AND]-containing hormonal contraception during the study period
EC6: 6. Use of systemic steroids within 1 month of study entry
EC8: 8. History of Hepatitis [OR] B [OR], C, or HIV
EC9: 9. Baseline creatinine >20% above the upper limit of normal for age
EC11: 11. Systolic blood pressure [OR] <85 or diastolic blood pressure <55
EC12: 12. Heart rate <50 at time of screening
